name: terraiq
description: TerraIQ monorepo orchestration (Next.js frontend + FastAPI backend + event worker)

scripts.dev: concurrently -n api,web -c blue,green "npm run dev:api" "npm run dev:frontend"
scripts.dev:all: concurrently -n api,web,worker -c blue,green,magenta "npm run dev:api" "npm run dev:frontend" "npm run dev:worker"
scripts.test:api:all: cd api/fastapi && python -m pytest test_agents.py test_strategy.py test_qdrant.py -q
